{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the data
print(df.dtypes)
print(df.head())
print(df['revenue'].unique()[:10])  # Check format of revenue
print(f"Number of rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Number of unique order_id: {df['order_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {df['status'].eq('refunded').sum()}")
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue == 999999.99): {(df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum()}")
print(f"Number of customer_age == -1: {(df['customer_age'] == -1).sum()}")

# Check for duplicates
print(f"Number of duplicate order_id: {df['order_id'].duplicated().sum()}")

# Check if revenue is string and contains commas
print("Sample of revenue strings:", df['revenue'].sample(5).values)

# Check channel and segment distribution
print("Channel distribution:\n", df['channel'].value_counts())
print("Customer segment distribution:\n", df['customer_segment'].value_counts())"}
